text:
liam: morning folks  I'm on team Search and kicking off my laptop. quick access runbook question: i need GCP access to `redwood-asia-staging` (BigQuery read + ability to create service accounts for a demo), and an AWS cross-account role for read-only S3 in ap-southeast-1. who should I ping to get this tied to the APAC billing account?
neha-peopleops: welcome liam! please complete the cloud access form (People Ops) and add your manager neha@redwood.com as approver. link: https://redwood.internal/onboard-cloud. once we have approval i can raise the infra ticket.
kai-infra: hey! for GCP we'll typically grant `roles/bigquery.dataViewer` + `roles/iam.serviceAccountCreator` scoped to the project. if you need to create service accounts that are used by infra, we ask you to request `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on specific service accounts instead. paste the full project id and I'll start the PR for IAM bindings.
liam: project id is `redwood-asia-staging-02`. demo uses a managed Cloud SQL instance too, so add `roles/cloudsql.client` please.
omar-billing: billing should be `redwood-apac-billing`. to link the project i need the project id + owner email. i'll only link after people-ops confirms manager approval. if this is for a customer demo and needs separate billing, ping me with the customer name.
devex: pro tip: infra can apply bindings with terraform or gcloud. quick gcloud snippets we use in infra-onboard: ```bash
# BigQuery viewer
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-asia-staging-02 \
  --member=\"user:liam@redwood.com\" \
  --role=\"roles/bigquery.dataViewer\"

# Cloud SQL client
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-asia-staging-02 \
  --member=\"user:liam@redwood.com\" \
  --role=\"roles/cloudsql.client\"
```
kai-infra: for the AWS S3 read, we create a role in the source account with a trust policy for our SAML/OIDC principal and give you an assume-role ARN like `arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/RedwoodS3ReadAPAC`. open an eng-infra ticket titled `APAC: S3 read role for liam` with the path to the bucket.
liam: thanks, opened ticket https://redwood.internal/tickets/ND-4998 (includes bucket path: s3://redwood-asia-data/demos). form submitted and manager approved.
identity-bot: ticket ND-4998 created and assigned to kai-infra. ETA: 8 business hours.
kai-infra: got it. will prepare the IAM PR and ping omar for billing link once people-ops confirms.
neha-peopleops: confirmed approval on the form. moving to infra. welcome aboard! :tada:
